title: Challenge-Aware Knowledge Recruitment with Meta-Agent Supervision for Medical Multi-Agent Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.05393v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language models perform strongly on standard medical QA but degrade on harder reasoning tasks, where multi-agent debate often fails to beat strong single-model prompting. We argue that a key limitation is that existing systems select experts and retrieve knowledge from the question alone, rather than from gaps that emerge during reasoning. We propose challenge-aware adaptive recruitment: an external CHALLENGER inspects the evolving reasoning trace and identifies specific factual or expertise gaps. These signals trigger targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment. On the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset (862 questions across nine biomedical datasets), upfront retrieval provides little benefit, while challenge-aware in-between retrieval performs better; on a multi-specialist backbone it improves accuracy on 8 of 9 datasets and adds 6 percentage points over Challenger Only. translated_title: 面向医疗多智能体推理的挑战感知知识招募与元智能体监督方法
translated_abstract: 大语言模型在标准医疗问答任务上表现强劲，但在更困难的推理任务上性能会下降，而多智能体辩论在此类任务上往往无法超越强大的单模型提示方法。我们认为一个关键局限在于：现有系统仅根据问题本身来选择专家和检索知识，而不是根据推理过程中涌现出的知识缺口。我们提出挑战感知的自适应招募机制：一个外部的“挑战者”检查不断演化的推理轨迹，并识别出具体的知识缺口或专业知识缺口。这些信号会触发针对性的知识检索，或在讨论中途招募领域专家。在MEDAGENTSBENCH困难子集（涵盖九个生物医学数据集的862个问题）上，事前检索几乎不带来收益，而挑战感知的推理中间检索表现更好；在多专家骨干系统上，该方法在9个数据集中的8个上提升了准确率，相比仅使用挑战者的方案提升了6个百分点。消融实验表明两者均有收益……
tldr: 该论文提出挑战感知的自适应招募框架，由外部挑战者智能体监控医疗多智能体推理过程中涌现的知识与专业缺口，动态触发针对性知识检索或讨论中途的专家招募，在MEDAGENTSBENCH困难子集上显著优于仅依赖问题的事前检索策略并提升多数据集准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a challenge-aware adaptive recruitment framework in which an external Challenger meta-agent inspects evolving reasoning traces to identify factual or expertise gaps and dynamically triggers targeted knowledge retrieval or mid-discussion specialist recruitment, outperforming upfront retrieval and improving accuracy across the MEDAGENTSBENCH hard subset.
